metadata.design_scope: Independent Bernoulli item columns; 30 uniformly sampled unique AND patterns on a shared 16-item pool. Overlap and nesting are allowed. Truth indicators are dependent and population occurrence is 0.65**order, not equal across orders. No disjoint-truth factorization of the unconditional response mean is assumed.
metadata.dictionary: training-frequent closed patterns of length at most 8
metadata.outcome_policy: Retain every declared seed and every sampled unique truth, regardless of supports, closure or response diagnostics.
metadata.seed_scope: The five seed IDs are reused from the disjoint mixed30 preflight, with a new generator/RNG namespace. These are exploratory shared-item datasets, not new independent confirmation results.
